description_en: Removes an EIP from an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用RemoveCommonBandwidthPackageIp接口移除共享带宽实例中的EIP
kebab_example: aliyun vpc remove-common-bandwidth-package-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqk1450000 --ip-instance-id eip-2zeerraiwb7uj6i0d0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveCommonBandwidthPackageIp

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. 

You can call the DescribeRegions (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vpc/developer-reference/api-vpc-2016-04-28-describeregions) operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
共享带宽实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vpc/developer-reference/api-vpc-2016-04-28-describeregions)接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the public IP address instance to be removed from the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

If IpType is set to EIP, specify the ID of the EIP. You can call the DescribeEipAddresses (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/eip/developer-reference/api-vpc-2016-04-28-describeeipaddresses-eips) operation to query EIP IDs.
If IpType is set to VpcIpv6, specify the ID of the IPv6 address in the VPC. You can call the DescribeIpv6Addresses operation to query IPv6 address IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要移出共享带宽的公网 IP 实例 ID。

IpType 为 EIP 时，传 EIP 实例 ID。您可以通过调用DescribeEipAddresses (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/eip/developer-reference/api-vpc-2016-04-28-describeeipaddresses-eips)接口查询 EIP 实例 ID。
IpType 为 VpcIpv6 时，传 VPC 的 IPv6 实例 ID。您可以通过调用 DescribeIpv6Addresses 接口查询 IPv6 实例 ID
parameters.name: ip_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run
parameters.name: dry_run
